scope: Single Linux process/writer, cooperative advisory lock, trusted stable pre-existing directory, bounded local regular-file journal. Process/cache remains alive in SIGKILL tests; no actual power loss or exchange/feed claim.

format.checksum: IEEE CRC32 over first76 bytes, previous record CRC chained; accidental integrity only

ack: Prevalidate candidate state; complete record write; successful file fsync; noexcept state install; return contiguous ordinal. Constructor syncs file and parent directory before usable handle. EINTR retried, short write/read continued, zero write refused. No I/O error returns ack; handle poisoned until close/recover.
recovery: Read/CRC/structure/chronology validate every complete80-byte record and replay through original engine. Complete invalid record refuses without repair. Incomplete final1..79 bytes explicitly reported and ftruncate+fsync before reuse. Complete unacknowledged records may recover; full-tail deletion cannot be inferred without external high-water mark.

fixed_study.event_rng: std::mt19937_64 modulo fixed domains, fixed draw order in source
fixed_study.oracle: canonical bytes each append vs uninterrupted engine; independent Python vector matcher/counter/FIFO serialization at all64 reopens and all4096 byte-decoded input frames

process_crashes.readiness: pipe notification then parent SIGKILL and waitpid; no timing guess
process_crashes.expected: 0-beforewrite recovers3; stages1..4 trim1/7/40/79 bytes and recover3; completewrite stages5..8 recover4 under live OS cache; not a persistence proof

io_faults: 7-byte short write +3 EINTR and sync EINTR
append fsync EIO (full unack record retained locally)

alternative_policy_model.assumption: idealized fsync advances durable prefix; modeled loss discards all unsynced bytes. Does not measure real storage, batching latency, or production exactly-once.

preserve: Original engine, matching oracle, snapshot format, old test/source fixtures and reference performance bytes. Original validation workflow unchanged; CMake only appends separate Linux journal targets.
result_rule: All fixed cases executed; any failure aborts visible with amendment before rerun. No case deletion, seed or scope retuning based on outcomes. CRC and I/O checks are automated evidence, not practitioner review.

amendments.timing: After fixed local study passed, before main/recruiter publication. Original source safety review found unbounded quantities could overflow original engine totals.
amendments.change: Journal-specific 1e9 positive event quantity ceiling checked on append and decoded recovery. With100000 records, total input/filled/resting quantities <=1e14. Two new invalid append cases and one resealed oversized record. Original matcher/source remain byte-identical.
amendments.study_impact: All original 4096 event quantities are1..100; all8 completed study files and budgets/seeds/event order preserved byte-identically. No deletion or outcome-dependent retuning.
